description: This file defines a singleton object 'StringUtils' providing utility functions 'join' and 'split' that operate on a custom LinkedList type. It serves as a utility component within the project, facilitating string manipulation tasks by delegating to other utility classes.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: A singleton object providing string utility functions such as join and split.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Converts a LinkedList into a String by delegating to JoinUtils.join.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a String into a LinkedList by delegating to SplitUtils.split.
